verdicts.note: Checked live: Slade's opened in 1928. Russell bought it in 1964 and ran it as a jazz room. It closed in 1992, then reopened under new ownership and now operates at 958 Tremont St. Dates and wording fixed in food.json.

summary: The dossiers largely match the verified facts: trade, roster, schedule, Cup group and Specter details all hold. Five errors are corrected. Slade's opened in 1928, not 1935, and has new owners. Bodega's neighborhood is fixed in the uniform file. So are the Head of the Charles timing, the MLK Day line and the parquet wood. Live checks confirmed Slade's and Bodega are open. Converse HQ and Concepts stay unverified. Strategy still needs fixes: the Slade's description, hard-coded Specter dates, the Lakers and Black History game dates, and the Concepts location.
